thread:
natalie: Planning a quiet canary for cobalt-6b-quant tomorrow 03:15-04:15 UTC. Start 5%, gated ramps, and modify fallback only for routes tagged 'dev-experiment'. Need a pin for billing routes.
ryan: sounds good. what backstop metrics?
sophia: propose auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 increase > 35% for 10m window. also watch token decode errors and kv hit-rate.
natalie: agreed. will set deploybot hold at 20% for manual ack. ops snippet: ```yaml
model: cobalt-6b-quant
fallback: [cobalt-6b-quant, cobalt-6b-fp16, cobalt-6b-legacy]
tags: ["experimental"]
canary: 5 -> 20 (hold) -> 50
backstop: error_rate_pct: 0.5
p95_increase_pct: 35
```
ops-bot: Reminder: pin billing routes before canary: `/catalog pin billing cobalt-6b-fp16 --reason="latency/accuracy SLA"`
deploybot: /deploy enable-model cobalt-6b-quant --canary=5 --window=2026-05-11T03:15Z/2026-05-11T04:15Z --notify=eng-releases
ryan: i'll be oncall for the window. will watch traces and KV warmup.
ops-bot: KV warmup scheduled 10m prior.
deploybot: Canary live 5% at 2026-05-11T03:15:05Z. telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/rollouts/2934567001
sophia: early: p95 +28%, error_rate 0.04%, kv hit-rate 65% (baseline 80%)  okay to continue to 20% after hold.
ryan: Hold reached at 20%  manual ack required from @ryan.
ryan: manual ack granted, proceed to 50%.
deploybot: Ramp to 50% complete, no backstop triggered. will update catalog after 48h if stable.
natalie: thanks team  I'll post release note and remove 'experimental' tag after verification.
